entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this ridiculous helmet I bought. Your service is unbelievable.
I do apologize for the wait time, sir. I can certainly look into that return for you. To start, could I get your name and order number?
The name is Tom Wilson, order number is VF8675309. Now hurry up, I don't have all day.
Thank you, Mr. Wilson. I have your order right here. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's an issue with my eyes! The color is absolutely not what it looked like online. It's hideous. I'm not wearing this thing. I want my money back. I'll leave a review on every website you can imagine if this isn't sorted out right now.
I understand your frustration when an item doesn't meet your expectations. Just to confirm, have you used the item at all?
No! The box is unopened. I took one look at it and knew I wasn't keeping it. I don't care about the fancy safety features if it looks this bad. Get me your manager.
That won't be necessary, sir, I can handle this for you. I'm just pulling up our policy. I can see the helmet was delivered to you 64 days ago.
So what? It's a brand new, unused item. If you try to deny this, I'm taking it to social media. VeloFit is going to regret it.

Not at all, Mr. Wilson. For a standard item like this helmet, our return policy is 90 days from the date of delivery. Since the box is unopened and you're at day 64, you are well within the window. I can authorize this return for a full refund immediately.
Oh. Well... good. That's what I expected. So what happens now?

I've just emailed you a pre-paid return shipping label. Just attach it to the shipping box and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see the full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's it. Just send the label. Thanks.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
